forces.title: Growing demand for critical minerals for battery storage systems
forces.description: Demand for critical minerals such as lithium and nickel, which are essential building blocks for electrification, renewables, and battery storage, is projected to grow significantly through 2040. This sustained demand provides a strong tailwind for the energy storage sector, ensuring a market for its core components and driving investment in the supply chain, though it also signals potential future supply challenges.
forces.source_title: Harnessing AI to make mining safer

forces.title: Increased investment in grid reliability and storage infrastructure
forces.description: In response to escalating energy security concerns and the accelerating clean energy transition, investments in electricity grids and storage infrastructure have notably increased. This focus on enhancing grid reliability and facilitating the integration of diverse electricity sources creates a supportive environment for the deployment of energy storage systems across Europe, boosting grid resilience and enabling greater renewable energy penetration.
forces.source_title: Aftershocks: Energy security beyond the Strait of Hormuz crisis

forces.title: Hybrid AC/DC power architecture benefits DC-native energy storage systems
forces.description: The global energy system is undergoing a structural shift towards a hybrid AC/DC architecture, with direct current (DC) increasingly powering high-density applications behind the meter. As solar PV generates DC and batteries natively store it, this transition inherently favors DC-native energy storage systems by reducing conversion inefficiencies and magnifying cost savings, making them more attractive for industrial plants, commercial buildings, and data centers.
forces.source_title: The Strategic Case for Hybrid AC/DC Power

forces.title: V2G functionality transforming EVs into grid-interactive energy storage assets
forces.description: The development of Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) functionality is transforming electric vehicles (EVs) into bidirectional, grid-interactive energy storage assets. As V2G standards mature and charging hardware becomes commercially viable, investment is accelerating to build infrastructure for real-time load balancing and peak shaving, presenting a new demand vector for grid-scale energy storage and integration in Europe, leveraging existing EV batteries.
forces.source_title: The power conversion market: Decarbonization and growth opportunities

forces.title: Increasing need for grid stability from intermittent renewable energy sources
forces.description: As intermittent power sources like solar and wind constitute a growing share of the energy supply, the demand for greater energy storage capacity is rising significantly. This is crucial for addressing grid stability challenges, improving capacity utilization, enabling flexible dispatch, and monetizing hybrid assets, particularly in regions like Europe working towards ambitious renewable energy targets and grid modernization.
forces.source_title: The power conversion market: Decarbonization and growth opportunities

forces.title: Price pressure and commoditization in lower-complexity energy storage segments
forces.description: Lower-complexity segments of the power conversion market, such as those related to residential solar PV and heat pumps, face significant price compression and commoditization. This competitive environment, driven by intense competition and market saturation in regions like Europe, shifts the focus primarily to cost optimization and supply chain scale, posing a risk to the profitability for players heavily invested in these particular energy storage segments.
forces.source_title: The power conversion market: Decarbonization and growth opportunities

forces.title: High total cost of ownership as a primary purchasing criterion for BESS
forces.description: Surveyed customers in Europe and the US for battery energy storage systems (BESS) prioritize total cost of ownership as their key purchasing criterion. This strong focus indicates significant price pressure across the BESS market, potentially leading to slower growth or market contraction if cost efficiencies are not met. It demands a strong emphasis on cost optimization and value delivery from BESS suppliers to remain competitive.
forces.source_title: The power conversion market: Decarbonization and growth opportunities

forces.title: Fragmented DC standards impede widespread adoption of DC-native systems
forces.description: Fragmented and inconsistent standards across DC voltage ranges and regions create a significant barrier to the widespread adoption of DC systems. This lack of standardization requires product redesign, retesting, or project-specific approvals, which in turn increases costs and slows deployment for DC-native energy storage solutions, despite their inherent advantages in a hybrid grid. Harmonization of standards is crucial for market acceleration.
forces.source_title: The Strategic Case for Hybrid AC/DC Power

forces.title: Workforce lacking DC-specific expertise for energy storage deployment
forces.description: A critical barrier to the adoption and scaled deployment of DC-native energy storage systems is the lack of specialized expertise among electrical engineers and electricians for designing, protecting, integrating, and commissioning DC systems. This skills gap, akin to early challenges in the solar industry, needs to be addressed through targeted retraining and parallel standards development to prevent delays in project execution and increase costs across Europe.
forces.source_title: The Strategic Case for Hybrid AC/DC Power

forces.title: Cost differential of DC components narrowing due to scaling power electronics
forces.description: The perception that DC components are inherently more expensive is becoming a myth, as their premium primarily reflects lower manufacturing volumes compared to comparable AC equipment. As power-electronics platforms, used in solar inverters, EV drives, and industrial converters, achieve greater scale, the cost differential for DC components crucial for battery storage is expected to narrow significantly, enhancing economic viability and accelerating adoption across Europe.
forces.source_title: The Strategic Case for Hybrid AC/DC Power

forces.title: Blackouts increase scrutiny on grid stability, driving BESS demand
forces.description: The spring 2025 blackouts in Spain and Portugal have intensified scrutiny on grid stability and data security within utility-scale solar PV applications. This heightened concern creates a structural tailwind for battery energy storage systems, as they are crucial for providing grid-stabilizing features and ensuring reliable power supply in an increasingly renewable-dominated energy landscape in Europe. Regulators and utilities will increasingly prioritize such solutions.
forces.source_title: The power conversion market: Decarbonization and growth opportunities

viewpoints.title: BESS power conversion market to triple by 2030, driven by utility-scale expansion
viewpoints.description: McKinsey forecasts the global BESS power conversion equipment market to reach $12 billion by 2030, growing at an 18% CAGR from 2024. This significant growth is propelled by the deployment of utility-scale, grid-connected storage across all major regions, including Europe and the United States, as they work towards renewable energy targets. This indicates a strong positive outlook for the energy storage sector, particularly for large-scale applications and their critical power conversion components.
viewpoints.source_title: The power conversion market: Decarbonization and growth opportunities

viewpoints.title: Energy transition and AI fuel sustained growth in power conversion, BESS shows compelling opportunities
viewpoints.description: McKinsey identifies the overall power conversion market as poised for sustained growth, underpinned by increasing electrification across industries, buildings, and mobility, alongside demands from AI. Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) are highlighted as a high-growth segment presenting compelling opportunities for equipment players and investors in Europe. This suggests a strong positive outlook for BESS, particularly for those integrating software, services, and grid-forming capabilities.
viewpoints.source_title: The power conversion market: Decarbonization and growth opportunities

viewpoints.title: Residential and commercial solar PV inverter market expected to decline due to price pressure
viewpoints.description: The market for power conversion technologies in residential and commercial solar PV, which includes hybrid inverters integrating storage for home battery systems, is expected to contract at about 4% annually to $13 billion by 2030. This decline is attributed to intense pricing pressure and market saturation in mature regions such as Europe. This suggests a cautious-negative outlook for components within the home battery systems segment if their economics are closely tied to these specific inverter trends.
viewpoints.source_title: The power conversion market: Decarbonization and growth opportunities

demand_drivers.description: All major regions, including Europe, are deploying grid-scale energy storage to support renewable energy targets and enhance overall grid stability.

The increasing share of intermittent power sources like solar and wind in the energy supply drives demand for greater energy storage capacity to ensure grid stability, improve capacity utilization, and enable flexible dispatch.

new_opportunities.description: OEMs are developing novel inverters that embed advanced control, energy management systems, and grid-forming capabilities to facilitate new use cases such as energy trading and virtual power-plant networks.
new_opportunities.opportunity: Energy trading and virtual power-plant networks

market_sizing.methodology: The global BESS power conversion equipment market is expected to triple by 2030 from its 2024 value of $4.2 billion, reaching approximately $12 billion by 2030. This calculation is based on the deployment of utility-scale, grid-connected storage across all major regions, including Europe and the United States, as they aim to achieve renewable energy targets. The market size covers power conversion equipment (inverters) for BESS.
market_sizing.source_title: The power conversion market: Decarbonization and growth opportunities
